summary: Tasklio (offline Expo/RN rewards app) frontend tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) via Expo web preview. Core flows verified: splash animation navigates to /home; home shows greeting, points badge, banner carousel, game tiles, wallet card and recent activity; drawer menu opens and Restricted Area routes to /restricted; wrong PIN shows error toast and stays on screen, correct PIN 1234 opens /admin; Spin & Win awards +100 pts; Tap Race start->rapid taps->end awards +50 pts; Lucky Draw pick awards +100 pts; Quiz Time options are selectable and advance; Puzzle Dash cards flip on tap; Wallet: chip 100 selected, valid UPI (test@bank), Request Payout succeeded, deducted points and created a Pending payout card + notification; Notifications screen renders list with unread dots and a Clear button; Data persistence verified — 150 pts on home survives full page reload (AsyncStorage-backed). No React Native red screens, no console errors, only benign deprecation warnings from libraries. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / barcode-scanner / background-fetch) found.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on '[data-testid="drawer-restricted-area"]' can report 'Element is outside of the viewport' on small mobile viewport (390x844) because the panel content sits below the fold before the SlideInLeft animation settles. A scroll_into_view_if_needed works. Consider wrapping drawer contents in ScrollView so the Restricted Area is reliably reachable on shorter devices.

issues: Home ScrollView has no horizontal padding on left edge of banner carousel arrows dots — cosmetic only, fine.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses <Animated.View pointerEvents="none">; console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents into the style prop.

Console warns '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Search StyleSheet.create blocks for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and switch to the new boxShadow API (or use elevation on Android and boxShadow on web/iOS).

action_items: Move 'pointerEvents="none"' on Animated.View in app/index.tsx (shimmer) into style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} to silence the deprecation warning.
Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow (React Native 0.76+ / Reanimated web) wherever used to remove console warnings.
Wrap DrawerMenu panel contents in a ScrollView so the 'Restricted Area' row is always reachable on small screens (avoids the 'outside of viewport' interaction case).
(Optional) Add explicit cooldown-remaining UI/text on Spin/Lucky screens if not already shown so users know 30s cooldown is active after awarding.
critical_code_review_comments: app-store.tsx: state persistence uses AsyncStorage + expo-file-system/legacy backup — verified data survives full page reload.
requestPayout: correctly validates UPI regex and sufficient balance, deducts points, creates Pending payout + txn + notif atomically.
adminAdjust clamps points to Math.max(0, ...) — good.
importBackup validates typeof parsed.points === 'number' before applying — good defensive check.
No hardcoded backend URLs in frontend (app is fully offline as designed).
All interactive elements have testID attributes.
No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage — clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed flows (12/12 features exercised successfully)

seed_data_creation: None. All state generated during test runs via game play and wallet payout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mobile viewport 390x844. Testable testIDs: splash-screen, splash-app-name, home-screen, home-menu-button, home-points-badge, home-bell-button, home-banner-*, home-game-{spin|puzzle|quiz|tap|lucky}, home-wallet-card, drawer-menu, drawer-backdrop, drawer-close-button, drawer-restricted-area, drawer-{share|rate-us|join-community|help-support|terms-of-use|privacy-policy}, restricted-pin-input, restricted-unlock-button, spin-button, puzzle-card-{i}, puzzle-restart-button, puzzle-play-again, quiz-option-{i}, quiz-play-again, tap-race-start, tap-race-button, lucky-card-{i}, lucky-play-again, wallet-balance, wallet-chip-{100|500|1000}, wallet-upi-input, wallet-request-button, wallet-payout-{id}, notifications-clear-button, notification-{id}, admin-refresh-button, admin-points-input, admin-add-points, admin-remove-points, admin-status-{id}-{p|s|f}, admin-name-input, admin-email-input, admin-save-profile, admin-pin-input, admin-save-pin, admin-export, admin-import, admin-reset. Note: Tap Race uses 'tap-race-start' / 'tap-race-button' (NOT 'tap-start-button'). Use element.scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking drawer-restricted-area to avoid intermittent 'outside of viewport' errors.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Only cosmetic deprecation warnings (pointerEvents prop; shadow* style props) which don't affect functionality but should be migrated for RN 0.76+/web compatibility.
